official_title: The Use of Toxin Botulinum A Toxin in Patients With Parkinson's Disease and Multiple System Disease, Affected by Refractory Detrusor Overactivity.
summary: The researchers investigated the effectiveness and safety of BoNT/A injected into the detrusor muscle in patients with PD and MSA all of whom had detrusor muscle overactivity unresponsive to conventional medical therapy.
title: Botulinum A Toxin in Patients With Parkinson's Disease
